why_trail.why: Loaded global-crew/global-everyone doctrine and this repo's CREW_CONTEXT.md/GLOSSARY.md deltas. Handoff (issue #534 + dispatch prompt) is complete: task (map_orient.py probes only docs/architecture/, misses this repo's map/INDEX.md), scope (scripts/map_orient.py, tests/test_map_orient.py, judiciously scripts/code_map/render.py for option 3), exclusions (mcp_*, install_constellation.py, .claude/settings.json, skills/**), required evidence (RED-then-GREEN regression test against the real repo root, full suite green), stop condition (PR opened against main, not merged).

Reproduced: python3 scripts/map_orient.py orient --root . --work-id repro-534 printed DEGRADED-NO-MAP (exit 10), probing only 3 docs/architecture/ paths, all absent. Read scripts/map_orient.py in full (1733 lines): the #315 failure mode note pins UNRESOLVABLE-ROOT vs DEGRADED-NO-MAP as never-collapse; the candidate mechanism (Candidate dataclass, collect_candidates, ordered kind list) already supports appending more candidates without disturbing existing precedence.

RED demonstrated: git stash push -- scripts/map_orient.py (test file kept), reran pytest -k test_this_repo_resolves_non_degraded_no_map -- failed with AssertionError: 'DEGRADED-NO-MAP' == 'DEGRADED-NO-MAP', plus test_every_candidate_is_recorded_even_after_a_hit failed on the old 4-kind list. git stash pop restored the fix. GREEN: added CODE_MAP_DIRNAME/CODE_MAP_INDEX/CODE_MAP_IDS constants and two ordered candidates (code-map-index, code-map-ids) probed after every docs/architecture/ candidate; updated the docstring resolution rule to 6 items; updated the candidate-kind-list assertion. Verdict against this repo flips from DEGRADED-NO-MAP to DEGRADED-UNPARSEABLE (map/INDEX.md has real content but no struct:/capability:/... citable anchor in scripts/code_map's own id vocabulary -- documented as a deliberately untaken larger follow-up in the module docstring).

Named the two map-root filenames render.py writes as TOP_INDEX_FILENAME/IDS_FILENAME. Added CodeMapCandidateAlignment (4 tests) cross-checking map_orient's CODE_MAP_DIRNAME against code_map.cli.MAP_DIRNAME, CODE_MAP_INDEX/CODE_MAP_IDS against render.py's new constants, and both against the actually-committed map/INDEX.md + map/ids.jsonl files on disk. Regenerated map/INDEX.md via python -m scripts.code_map build --root . after the source edit changed tests/test_map_orient.py's entity count (120->125 entities); freshness test was RED before the rebuild, GREEN after -- live proof the freshness-enforcing side actually enforces. A live import between the two modules is not possible: map_orient.py ships standalone into consuming repos with no scripts/code_map, so this same-repo cross-check test is the strongest tie available, not a full elimination of the two literals.

self-test OK; python3 scripts/map_orient.py orient --root . --work-id final-534-check now reads DEGRADED-UNPARSEABLE (not DEGRADED-NO-MAP), exit 10, candidates_tried includes code-map-index=map/INDEX.md (unparseable) and code-map-ids=map/ids.jsonl (empty). Full suite: 2143 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing), 0 failed.
